high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white illustration that combines text and a detailed drawing. The text at the top reads: "Eternity is an image of God, the cosmos is an image of eternity, the sun an image of the cosmos, man an image of the sun" (Corpus Hermeticum XI, 15). This quote suggests a philosophical or theological concept about the interconnectedness of different aspects of existence. Below the text, there is a circular diagram divided into sections. The diagram appears to represent a hierarchical or nested structure, with concentric circles and lines connecting various elements.
